pages.text: The Bio-Digester digests $(l)Biomass$() into $(l)Biogas$(), a gas fuel for the $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l) and the $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l). With a farm feeding it, it is power that runs without coal.

$(li)Place the digester, then $(l)2$() $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l): one on top of it and one on its left as you face it.$(br)$(li)$(l)Right-click$() it while it is alone and drones show where the frames go.$(br)$(li)Once complete, the upper drum rises and a tank slides out beside it, its sight glass showing the gas.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: $(li)It doesn't work until then. Breaking a frame folds it back.$(br)$(li)Connect an $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) to the machine block or to one of its frames.

$(li)It accepts only $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass$(/l), from a $(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l).$(br)$(li)It pushes the gas into adjacent $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l), tanks or a Gas Turbine.$(br)$(li)Pipes connect to the machine block, on its free sides.$(br)$(li)An empty bucket on it fills a Biogas Bucket once it holds 1,000 mB (see $(l:generators/gas_power)Gas Power$(/l)).
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

$(li)$(l)Power$(): 8 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Time per Biomass$(): 2.5 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Biogas per Biomass$(): 500 mB$(br)$(li)$(l)Output while fed$(): 10 mB/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Gas tank$(): 8,000 mB$(br)$(li)$(l)One Biomass in a Gas Turbine$(): 2,500 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)One Biomass in a Steam Engine$(): 4,500 FE
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: One digester feeds 50 FE/t worth of gas to a Gas Turbine. $(l)Two digesters$() keep one Gas Turbine at full power.
A Harvester drone, a hopper into a Biomass Press and the press's nozzle pointing at the digester make a fully automatic biogas farm.
